# Luna: Period Tracker for Teens

> Luna is a period tracker app for teens, tweens, and anyone starting their period, made by Dotty Apps LLC for iOS and Android. It has cycle predictions designed for young, still-irregular cycles, prep-day reminders before a period is due, symptom, flow and mood logging, interactive lessons, and a Question Box of answers to common period and puberty questions. Luna has no ads and never sells user data. A parent or guardian can optionally link to a child's Luna to see upcoming periods; the child's notes stay private. Luna+ is an optional subscription that adds backup, photo backgrounds and stickers, and covers a linked child's backup.

Contact: hello@lunatracker.app

## Learn

Lessons for teens and pre-teens, written in plain words and copied from the app's Learn tab.

- [Normal Periods as a Teen (or Pre-teen)](https://lunatracker.app/learn/normal-teen-periods.html): Why periods are irregular for the first couple of years, what counts as normal for teens and pre-teens, and when to talk to a doctor about your cycle.
- [Period Supplies](https://lunatracker.app/learn/period-supplies.html): Pads, tampons, period underwear, liners and menstrual cups: what each one is and how to use it, plus what to do if you stain your clothes.
- [Top Tips for Handling Period Cramps](https://lunatracker.app/learn/handling-cramps.html): What causes period cramps, five things that can make them feel better (heat, medicine, exercise, food), and when to talk to a doctor about them.
- [Your First Period](https://lunatracker.app/learn/first-period.html): Signs your first period is on the way, how to make a period kit, what happens during it, and what to do if it shows up when you're not ready.
- [The Reproductive System](https://lunatracker.app/learn/reproductive-system.html): An interactive diagram of the uterus, ovaries, fallopian tubes, cervix and vagina. Tap each part to see what it does and how it fits into your period.
- [The Menstrual Cycle](https://lunatracker.app/learn/how-periods-work.html): Step through a whole menstrual cycle: the period, the uterine lining rebuilding, ovulation, and the next period. An interactive guide for teens.
- [How Do Hormones Work?](https://lunatracker.app/learn/hormones.html): How estrogen and progesterone change during your cycle, why they can change how you feel, and what to say when someone says you're "just PMSing."
- [Question Box](https://lunatracker.app/questions.html): 34 questions about periods as a teen, how periods work, self care, talking to adults, puberty, reproductive system, pregnancy, about luna
